title: Sliced Tongues
description: A single pitched dirt hit is chopped into a granular vocal cloud, its grains stuttering forward and in reverse at stepped speeds. Over a 32-cycle pass the grain count, formant vowel, crush and a room+delay tail breathe so the cloud thickens, smears backwards, then thins again.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
stack(
  s("east*2")
    .chop("<16 24 16 12>/2")
    .striate("<1 1 2 1>/4")
    .speed("<1 -1 0.5 -0.75 1 -1 1.5 -0.5>")
    .n("<0 1 0 2>/4")
    .vowel("<a e i o u a o e>/2")
    .crush(saw.slow(23).range(16, 6))
    .shape(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.5))
    .bpf(perlin.range(500, 2400).slow(11))
    .resonance(sine.slow(29).range(6, 14))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .gain(0.85)
    .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(-2))
    .room(sine.slow(16).range(0.3, 0.8))
    .roomsize(sine.slow(17).range(3, 8))
    .delay("0.4:0.1875:0.6")
)
